```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(scales)
library(DT)

# Load processed dashboard data
dashboard_data <- readRDS("../data/processed/dashboard_data.rds")

kpi <- dashboard_data$kpi
t12 <- dashboard_data$t12
valuation_long <- dashboard_data$valuation_long
loan_long <- dashboard_data$loan_long

# Color palette
colors <- list(
  primary = "#1e3a8a",
  success = "#059669",
  warning = "#d97706",
  danger = "#dc2626",
  fund_i = "#3b82f6",
  fund_ii = "#10b981",
  egi = "#6366f1",
  fixed = "#f59e0b",
  variable = "#ef4444",
  noi = "#10b981"
)
```

### Fund Capital Allocation

```{r}
fund_data <- tibble(
  Fund = c("Fund I", "Fund II"),
  Capital = c(kpi$fund_i_icc, kpi$fund_ii_icc),
  Percent = c(kpi$fund_i_icc, kpi$fund_ii_icc) / kpi$total_icc
)

plot_ly(fund_data, 
        labels = ~Fund, 
        values = ~Capital, 
        type = 'pie',
        hole = 0.5,
        textinfo = 'label+percent',
        textposition = 'outside',
        marker = list(colors = c(colors$fund_i, colors$fund_ii)),
        hovertemplate = "%{label}<br>%{value:$,.0f}<br>%{percent}<extra></extra>") |>
  layout(
    showlegend = TRUE,
    legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.1),
    annotations = list(
      text = paste0("<b>", dollar(kpi$total_icc, scale = 1e-6, suffix = "M"), "</b><br>Total"),
      showarrow = FALSE,
      font = list(size = 16)
    )
  )
```

### T-12 Financial Performance Trend

```{r}
t12_long <- t12 |>
  select(month, egi, fixed_expense, variable_expense, noi) |>
  pivot_longer(-month, names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(
    metric = case_when(
      metric == "egi" ~ "Effective Gross Income",
      metric == "fixed_expense" ~ "Fixed Expenses",
      metric == "variable_expense" ~ "Variable Expenses",
      metric == "noi" ~ "Net Operating Income"
    ),
    metric = factor(metric, levels = c("Effective Gross Income", "Fixed Expenses", 
                                        "Variable Expenses", "Net Operating Income"))
  )

color_map <- c(
  "Effective Gross Income" = colors$egi,
  "Fixed Expenses" = colors$fixed,
  "Variable Expenses" = colors$variable,
  "Net Operating Income" = colors$noi
)

plot_ly(t12_long, x = ~month, y = ~value, color = ~metric, 
        colors = color_map, type = 'scatter', mode = 'lines+markers',
        hovertemplate = "%{x}<br>%{y:$,.0f}<extra>%{fullData.name}</extra>") |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = ""),
    yaxis = list(title = "", tickformat = "$,.0f"),
    legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.15),
    hovermode = "x unified"
  )
```

### EGI Breakdown: Expenses vs NOI

```{r}
# Stacked bar with clear visual separation between expenses (red tones) and NOI (green)
expense_data <- t12 |>
  mutate(
    total_expenses = fixed_expense + variable_expense,
    fixed_pct = fixed_expense / egi * 100,
    variable_pct = variable_expense / egi * 100,
    noi_pct = noi / egi * 100
  )

plot_ly(expense_data, x = ~month) |>
  # Expenses section (warm colors, stacked together)
  add_trace(y = ~fixed_expense, name = "Fixed Expenses", 
            type = 'bar',
            marker = list(color = "#fbbf24", line = list(color = "#f59e0b", width = 1)),
            text = ~paste0(round(fixed_pct, 0), "%"),
            textposition = "inside",
            hovertemplate = "Fixed Expenses<br>%{y:$,.0f} (%{text})<extra></extra>") |>
  add_trace(y = ~variable_expense, name = "Variable Expenses", 
            type = 'bar',
            marker = list(color = "#f87171", line = list(color = "#ef4444", width = 1)),
            text = ~paste0(round(variable_pct, 0), "%"),
            textposition = "inside",
            hovertemplate = "Variable Expenses<br>%{y:$,.0f} (%{text})<extra></extra>") |>
  # NOI section (green with distinct styling)
  add_trace(y = ~noi, name = "Net Operating Income", 
            type = 'bar',
            marker = list(
              color = "#34d399",
              line = list(color = "#059669", width = 2),
              pattern = list(shape = "/", solidity = 0.1)
            ),
            text = ~paste0(round(noi_pct, 0), "%"),
            textposition = "inside",
            textfont = list(color = "#065f46", size = 12, weight = "bold"),
            hovertemplate = "NOI (Profit)<br>%{y:$,.0f} (%{text})<extra></extra>") |>
  layout(
    barmode = 'stack',
    xaxis = list(title = ""),
    yaxis = list(title = "Effective Gross Income", tickformat = "$,.0f"),
    legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.15, 
                  traceorder = "normal"),
    hovermode = "x unified",
    annotations = list(
      list(x = 0.5, y = 1.08, xref = "paper", yref = "paper",
           text = "<b>EXPENSES</b> (Fixed + Variable) vs <b style='color:#059669'>NOI</b> (Profit)",
           showarrow = FALSE, font = list(size = 11))
    )
  )
```

### Cap Rate Trend

```{r}
plot_ly(t12, x = ~month, y = ~cap_rate, type = 'scatter', mode = 'lines+markers',
        line = list(color = colors$primary, width = 3),
        marker = list(size = 10, color = colors$primary),
        hovertemplate = "%{x}<br>Cap Rate: %{y:.2%}<extra></extra>") |>
  add_trace(y = rep(kpi$potential_cap_rate, nrow(t12)), 
            name = "Target (9.16%)",
            line = list(color = colors$success, width = 2, dash = "dash"),
            marker = list(size = 0),
            hovertemplate = "Target: %{y:.2%}<extra></extra>") |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = ""),
    yaxis = list(title = "Capitalization Rate", tickformat = ".1%", 
                 range = c(0, max(kpi$potential_cap_rate * 1.1, 0.1))),
    legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.15),
    annotations = list(
      list(x = "Oct", y = kpi$potential_cap_rate, 
           text = "Stabilized Target", showarrow = FALSE,
           xanchor = "left", yanchor = "bottom",
           font = list(color = colors$success, size = 10))
    )
  )
```

### Portfolio Valuation: Current vs Target Position

```{r}
# Current and target positions
current_noi <- t12$noi[nrow(t12)]  # Oct 2025: ~$134K
current_cap <- t12$cap_rate[nrow(t12)] * 100  # ~3.6%
current_value <- current_noi / (current_cap / 100)

target_noi <- kpi$potential_noi_2026  # ~$260K
target_cap <- kpi$potential_cap_rate * 100  # ~9.16%
target_value <- target_noi / (target_cap / 100)

# Focus on relevant range around current and target
noi_range <- seq(100000, 300000, by = 20000)
cap_range <- seq(3, 10, by = 0.5)

# Build valuation matrix
val_grid <- expand_grid(noi = noi_range, cap_rate = cap_range) |>
  mutate(value = noi / (cap_rate / 100))

val_matrix <- val_grid |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = noi, values_from = value) |>
  arrange(cap_rate)

z_vals <- as.matrix(val_matrix[, -1])

# Create heatmap with position markers
plot_ly() |>
  # Heatmap layer
  add_heatmap(
    x = noi_range, y = cap_range, z = z_vals,
    colorscale = list(
      list(0, "#dc2626"),    # Red - low value
      list(0.3, "#f97316"),  # Orange
      list(0.5, "#fbbf24"),  # Amber - mid
      list(0.7, "#84cc16"),  # Lime
      list(1, "#22c55e")     # Green - high value
    ),
    hovertemplate = "NOI: %{x:$,.0f}<br>Cap Rate: %{y:.1f}%<br>Value: %{z:$,.0f}<extra></extra>",
    colorbar = list(title = "Portfolio<br>Value", tickformat = "$,.0f", len = 0.8),
    showscale = TRUE
  ) |>
  # Current position marker (blue circle)
  add_trace(
    x = current_noi, y = current_cap,
    type = "scatter", mode = "markers+text",
    marker = list(size = 18, color = "#2563eb", 
                  line = list(color = "white", width = 3)),
    text = "CURRENT", textposition = "top center",
    textfont = list(color = "#1e40af", size = 11, family = "Arial Black"),
    hovertemplate = paste0(
      "<b>CURRENT POSITION</b><br>",
      "NOI: ", dollar(current_noi), "<br>",
      "Cap Rate: ", percent(current_cap/100, accuracy = 0.1), "<br>",
      "Value: ", dollar(current_value),
      "<extra></extra>"
    ),
    name = "Current (Oct 2025)"
  ) |>
  # Target position marker (green diamond)
  add_trace(
    x = target_noi, y = target_cap,
    type = "scatter", mode = "markers+text",
    marker = list(size = 18, color = "#16a34a", symbol = "diamond",
                  line = list(color = "white", width = 3)),
    text = "TARGET", textposition = "bottom center",
    textfont = list(color = "#166534", size = 11, family = "Arial Black"),
    hovertemplate = paste0(
      "<b>TARGET POSITION (2026)</b><br>",
      "NOI: ", dollar(target_noi), "<br>",
      "Cap Rate: ", percent(target_cap/100, accuracy = 0.1), "<br>",
      "Value: ", dollar(target_value),
      "<extra></extra>"
    ),
    name = "Target (2026)"
  ) |>
  # Arrow from current to target
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Net Operating Income (NOI)", tickformat = "$,.0f",
                 range = c(90000, 310000)),
    yaxis = list(title = "Capitalization Rate (%)", 
                 range = c(10.5, 2.5)),  # Reversed
    legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.12, x = 0.5, xanchor = "center"),
    annotations = list(
      list(
        x = target_noi, y = target_cap,
        ax = current_noi, ay = current_cap,
        xref = "x", yref = "y", axref = "x", ayref = "y",
        showarrow = TRUE,
        arrowhead = 2, arrowsize = 1.5, arrowwidth = 2,
        arrowcolor = "#7c3aed"
      ),
      list(
        x = 0.5, y = 1.06, xref = "paper", yref = "paper",
        text = "<b>Value = NOI / Cap Rate</b>  |  Higher NOI + Higher Cap Rate = Stabilized Value",
        showarrow = FALSE, font = list(size = 11, color = "#374151")
      )
    )
  )
```

### Loan Affordability by Interest Rate

```{r}
# Focus on practical interest rate range (5-9%) and debt service capacity
# Using current NOI as basis for debt service capacity
ds_capacity <- current_noi * 0.8  # 80% of NOI for debt service (1.25x DSCR)
ds_range <- seq(80000, 200000, by = 15000)
rate_range <- seq(5, 9, by = 0.5)

# Build loan matrix
loan_grid <- expand_grid(ds = ds_range, rate = rate_range) |>
  mutate(max_loan = ds / (rate / 100))

loan_matrix <- loan_grid |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = ds, values_from = max_loan) |>
  arrange(rate)

z_loan <- as.matrix(loan_matrix[, -1])

# Estimate current debt service capacity
current_ds <- current_noi * 0.8  # Assuming 1.25x DSCR target

plot_ly() |>
  add_heatmap(
    x = ds_range, y = rate_range, z = z_loan,
    colorscale = list(
      list(0, "#fef3c7"),   # Light amber - low loan
      list(0.5, "#60a5fa"), # Blue - mid
      list(1, "#1e3a8a")    # Dark blue - high loan
    ),
    hovertemplate = "Debt Service: %{x:$,.0f}/yr<br>Rate: %{y:.1f}%<br>Max Loan: %{z:$,.0f}<extra></extra>",
    colorbar = list(title = "Max Loan<br>Amount", tickformat = "$,.0f", len = 0.8),
    showscale = TRUE
  ) |>
  # Mark current DS capacity line
  add_trace(
    x = rep(current_ds, length(rate_range)),
    y = rate_range,
    type = "scatter", mode = "lines",
    line = list(color = "#dc2626", width = 3, dash = "dash"),
    name = paste0("Current DS Capacity (~", dollar(current_ds, accuracy = 1), ")"),
    hovertemplate = "Current DS Capacity<br>%{x:$,.0f}<extra></extra>"
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Annual Debt Service Capacity", tickformat = "$,.0f"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Interest Rate (%)", range = c(9.5, 4.5)),
    legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.12),
    annotations = list(
      list(
        x = 0.5, y = 1.06, xref = "paper", yref = "paper",
        text = "<b>Max Loan = Debt Service / Interest Rate</b>  |  Red line = Current capacity at 1.25x DSCR",
        showarrow = FALSE, font = list(size = 11, color = "#374151")
      )
    )
  )
```

### Key Metrics Summary

```{r}
metrics_table <- tibble(
  Metric = c(
    "Total Capital Invested (I.C.C.)",
    "Fund I Contribution",
    "Fund II Contribution",
    "Number of Units",
    "Potential Monthly Rent",
    "Potential Annual Rent",
    "2026 Projected NOI",
    "Stabilized Cap Rate",
    "Current T-12 NOI (Oct 2025)",
    "Current Cap Rate"
  ),
  Value = c(
    dollar(kpi$total_icc),
    dollar(kpi$fund_i_icc),
    dollar(kpi$fund_ii_icc),
    as.character(kpi$unit_count),
    dollar(kpi$potential_monthly_rent),
    dollar(kpi$potential_annual_rent),
    dollar(kpi$potential_noi_2026),
    percent(kpi$potential_cap_rate, accuracy = 0.01),
    dollar(t12$noi[nrow(t12)]),
    percent(t12$cap_rate[nrow(t12)], accuracy = 0.01)
  ),
  Category = c(
    rep("Capital", 3),
    rep("Portfolio", 4),
    rep("Returns", 3)
  )
)

datatable(
  metrics_table,
  options = list(
    pageLength = 15,
    dom = 't',
    ordering = FALSE
  ),
  rownames = FALSE,
  class = 'cell-border stripe'
) |>
  formatStyle(
    'Category',
    backgroundColor = styleEqual(
      c('Capital', 'Portfolio', 'Returns'),
      c('#eff6ff', '#f0fdf4', '#fef3c7')
    )
  )
```

### T-12 Monthly Data

```{r}
t12_display <- t12 |>
  mutate(
    `Effective Gross Income` = dollar(egi),
    `Fixed Expenses` = dollar(fixed_expense),
    `Variable Expenses` = dollar(variable_expense),
    `Net Operating Income` = dollar(noi),
    `Cap Rate` = percent(cap_rate, accuracy = 0.01),
    `Month` = as.character(month)
  ) |>
  select(Month, `Effective Gross Income`, `Fixed Expenses`, 
         `Variable Expenses`, `Net Operating Income`, `Cap Rate`)

datatable(
  t12_display,
  options = list(
    pageLength = 6,
    dom = 't',
    ordering = FALSE
  ),
  rownames = FALSE,
  class = 'cell-border stripe'
)
```
